**v1.14.1: a hitter blades itself again against a boss. Card logic 3 now knows a boss from the game's memory, a blade counts only once it's actually cast, and in a battle with a friend the bot finds its own name plate.**

All three fixes come from a storm wizard's battles against Luska Charmbeak (a rank 12 boss) on 2026-11-15, played with a friend's wizard. They haven't been tried in the game yet.

- **Fixed: hitting first against a boss with Card logic 3.**
  - **What was wrong:** "Boss: boost first - mobs: hit first" treated a battle as a boss battle only when you'd picked the boss with Alt+1. Every other boss was fought like a mob: Tempest every round, with Stormblade and Sharpen still in hand.
  - **Now:** a boss the game's memory shows among the enemies (the game's boss flag or the title Boss) also counts, and so does the boss the deck code found for the battle. Settings and the README say so.
- **Fixed: a blade click that cast nothing was counted as cast.**
  - **What was wrong:** the bot counted a blade as cast as soon as it clicked it. Twice in one battle the click cast nothing, and the bot took that as both of the blade's casts for the battle (plain and sharpened). It didn't blade again for the rest of the battle.
  - **Now:** a blade counts only once the Pass button disappears, the same check a hit gets. If it didn't go out, debug.log says "the card didn't go out ... not counted as cast" and the round moves on to the next card. The blade is tried again in a later round.
- **Fixed: taking a friend's name plate for your own.**
  - **What was wrong:** in a battle with more than one of your wizards, the bot finds its own plate by its wizard's name. The bot learns that name from a battle fought alone, or from party.ini. A wizard that only ever fights with a friend has no name learned, so the bot took the first name plate it saw, and that was the friend's. Its heals on itself and its count of its own blades went to the friend.
  - **Now:** with no name known, the wizard's name is read from the game's memory, as the game's log names it on your side. In a battle with a friend, the plate's position from the game's memory (with memclicks on) comes before the name pictures.
  - **A copied folder:** a party.ini copied from another PC still names that PC's wizard. Its character ID doesn't match yours, so it's ignored, but you can delete its `[me]` section.
- **Not fixed yet:** why some blade clicks miss. In those rounds the game's memory lists one more card than the screen shows. A miss now costs about a second instead of the blade's casts for the whole battle.
- **Checked:** the five release scripts load, and 887 of 888 vision tests pass, including 3 new ones (test_blades). `test_ahk_names`' speedhack path test errors, as on v1.12.0. The new name and boss checks were run with test values.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install. Your settings, learned cards, routes and recorded battles are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
